basic_details.job_title: IIITA Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 2 Research Associate, Junior Research Fellow Posts
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Information Technology, Indian Institute of Information Technology, Allahabad (IIITA), Prayagraj, has invited applications for one Research Associate-I (₹58,000 per month + HRA) and one Junior Research Fellow (₹37,000 per month + HRA) on a contractual basis. The posts are under the MeitY-sponsored project "An Agentic AI-Driven Automated VPN Detection and De-anonymization Framework for Threat Intelligence using Hybrid Approaches", funded by the Cyber Security Division, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology. Applications go by email to [email protected] in the Anne

qualification.details: Candidates with hands-on experience or good knowledge in two or more of the following areas will be preferred: | Computer Network (specially OSI Layer, Traffic Analysis and Communications Protocols) VPN and proxy identification using network traffic (Layer-7) and Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) Applying AI / ML / Deep Learning models for VPN detection and anomaly classification Using Agentic AI for automated or intelligent decision-making Graph-based analysis of network data Working with VPN and proxy repositories, including dark web indicators Packet capture and analysis using tools such as Wireshark, TShark, or tcpdump Developing web dashboards for data visualization and alerts Performing time-series and real-time network analysis using telemetry data Detecting network anomalies using adaptive thresholds Following ethical research practices in data handling and analysis | Knowledge of programming in Python and experience with shell scripting or similar tools for data processing and automation will be an added advantage.

how_to_apply: Fill the application in the prescribed format (Annexure-I), headed "Application Format (for candidates applying through email)".

Add the separate sheets the form asks for: M.Sc/M.E./M.Tech thesis summary (maximum 150 words), research publications (best 5, list only), experience details in chronological order, and any other information.
Attach copies of supporting documents in soft copy form only.
Email the application package to [email protected] with the subject line "Application for the post of JRF/RA-I".
Also fill the Google Form for the position applied for: JRF at https://forms.gle/brW1XC6JbAozGcDh7 or RA-I at https://forms.gle/zr7hZ3gRTGjzrwPf6.
For queries or application by email, the notice gives [email protected]. The Chief Investigator's contact is [email protected], 7376581984.
Mark sheets and certificates of all the examinations passed
important_instructions: Give a valid email ID in the application, as only shortlisted candidates are informed by email about the interview date. The applicant is responsible for the authenticity of the information, documents and scanned copies submitted. Selected candidates need to join immediately. No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview or joining the duty. The Institute reserves the right to accept applications at any time and to consider candidates of exceptional credentials without applications. Qualification and experience may be relaxed for exceptional candidates. Either the PI or the candidate can end the association at any time with one month's written notice. Selected candidates are encouraged to apply for the regular PhD programme at IIIT Allahabad, provided they meet its eligibility criteria and selection process.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice does not print a separate essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post in its table. Candidates should check the official notification for the JRF eligibility. Candidates with hands-on experience or good knowledge in two or more of the following areas will be preferred: Computer Network (specially OSI Layer, Traffic Analysis and Communications Protocols) VPN and proxy identification using network traffic (Layer-7) and Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) Applying AI / ML / Deep Learning models for VPN detection and anomaly classification Using Agentic AI for automated or intelligent decision-making Graph-based analysis of network data Working with VPN and proxy repositories, including dark web indicators Packet capture and analysis using tools such as Wireshark, TShark, or tcpdump Developing web dashboards for data visualization and alerts Performing time-series and real-time network analysis using telemetry data Detecting network anomalies using adaptive thresholds Following ethical research practices in data handling and analysis Knowledge of programming in Python and experience with shell scripting or similar tools for data processing and automation will be an added advantage.

rows.essential_qualification: Ph.D. OR 3 years of research, teaching or design and development experience after MSc/MS/ME/M.Tech, with at least one research paper published in a Science Citation Indexed (SCI/SCIE) journal.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Research Associate-I gets ₹58,000 per month + HRA and the Junior Research Fellow gets ₹37,000 per month + HRA, with HRA as per institute/project norms. The post is purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The appointment is purely contractual for one year initially and may be extended for another year or till completion of the project, whichever is earlier, based on satisfactory performance. The JRF can be promoted to SRF after two years of relevant research experience, and the RA-I can be promoted to RA-II after one year, in both cases on the recommendation of the project progress monitoring committee.

Also fill the Google Form for the position applied for: JRF at https://forms.gle/brW1XC6JbAozGcDh7 or RA-I at https://forms.gle/zr7hZ3gRTGjzrwPf6 . content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. Shortlisted candidates are contacted for interviews as and when suitable applications are received. Shortlisting is done based on the need of the project, and holding the prescribed qualification does not ensure an interview call. The interview will be conducted in Online/Offline mode, and details go only to shortlisted candidates by email. The notice gives no interview date.

No TA/DA is payable for appearing for the interview or joining the duty. Qualification and experience may be relaxed for exceptional candidates. Either the PI or the candidate can end the association at any time with one month's written notice. Selected candidates are encouraged to apply for the regular PhD programme at IIIT Allahabad, provided they meet its eligibility criteria and selection process.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIITA Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Research Associate-I (RA-I) and 1 Junior Research Fellow (JRF).

faq.question: Q2. What is the qualification for the RA-I post?
faq.answer: Ph.D., OR 3 years of research, teaching or design and development experience after MSc/MS/ME/M.Tech, with at least one research paper in an SCI/SCIE journal.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary for JRF and RA-I at IIITA?
faq.answer: The JRF gets ₹37,000 per month + HRA and the RA-I gets ₹58,000 per month + HRA, with HRA as per institute/project norms.

faq.question: Q4. Is HRA paid on top of the fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states the amounts as "+ HRA (as per institute/project norms)".

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IIITA JRF or RA-I post?
faq.answer: Email the Annexure-I application with soft copies of documents to [email protected], with the subject "Application for the post of JRF/RA-I". Also fill the Google Form for your post.

faq.question: Q6. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The notice gives no fixed closing date. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and the position will remain open until filled.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Candidates are shortlisted based on the need of the project and interviewed in Online/Offline mode. Only shortlisted candidates are informed by email.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The post is contractual and co-terminus with the project, for one year initially, extendable for another year or till project completion, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q9. Is TA/DA paid for the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA applies for appearing for the interview or joining the duty.
